principle: At least the preregistered group-specific semantic contrast must pass; pairs need not differ on every semantic dimension.

groups.timing_spike: opposite peak timing on the same narrow-spike workload
groups.timing_periodic: opposite repeated phase shift on the same periodic workload
groups.direction_bias: equal-magnitude persistent residuals with opposite signs
groups.duration: equal-magnitude shortening and extension with opposite duration signs
groups.event_presence: true event removed versus equal-energy event inserted in nonoverlapping stable region
groups.location: same residual magnitude and duration placed in stable versus transition phases
groups.shape: moving-average smoothing versus residual-mirrored sharpening with identical absolute residuals
